info.name: Analytics
info.summary: Business intelligence and reporting within Nextcloud
info.description:
Business intelligence and reporting within Nextcloud. Turn operational data into interactive reports and management dashboards, with your Analytics datasets hosted in your own Nextcloud environment.
- **Connect your data:** bring together spreadsheets, business systems, and Nextcloud data with visual data source configuration and live previews. - **Understand performance:** explore charts and tables with filters, drilldowns, calculated columns, and trends. - **Present the big picture:** combine reports in multi-page dashboards called panoramas and export them as PDF. - **Reduce manual work:** automate recurring data loads and highlight exceptions with thresholds and notifications. - **Collaborate with control:** share with users and groups or use password-protected public links. - **Explore deeper insights with Nextcloud Assistant:** ask questions about your data in natural language.
Bring insights into everyday collaboration with Analytics in your Nextcloud workspace.
info.author: Marcel Scherello
